cause: Background MCP OAuth creates sys.stdin.readline reader racing the agent composer; reader can survive canceled connect timeout and browser launch steals focus.
fix: Agent startup reserves stdin for its process lifetime. OAuth redirect/callback requires an explicit separate MCP login instead of starting a browser or stdin reader. Cached authentication remains intact.
